themes.title: Far-right parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying anti-immigration rhetoric and policies, framing migration as a national security and cultural threat. This theme appears in Germany, France, Italy, Spain, and the UK, with leaders proposing stricter border controls, deportations, and prioritization of native-born citizens in social services.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Criticizes EU migration policies, faces protests over migrant deaths at sea, and clashes with Germany over Dublin Regulation returns.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Proposes Germany exit Schengen, close borders, and deport migrants; leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt with anti-migrant platform.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen leads polls with hardline migration stance; local RN mayors remove Ukrainian flags and oppose migrant housing.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes prioritizing British-born workers for social housing and evicting foreign nationals; Nigel Farage's party investigates unpermitted events.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Proposes deporting unemployed Ukrainian men and creating 'Illegal alert' system for migrants.
